blurb:
Are you ready to party or relax in the beautiful Miami waters?
Welcome aboard and cruise on a 42ft Luxury Yacht through Miami’s Biscayne Bay with friends and family.

During this experience, we will start cruising the Miami Beach area by water, exploring the famous mansions.

Then drop our anchor at a Sandbar Area around Rusty Pelican, allowing our guests to swim with gorgeous views.
Lastly, we will head back to the Marina
